theme: buy machines once, job mixes keep changing
title: One Purchase, Nine Mixes: Hedging a Workshop's Machine Portfolio
strategies: trivial: spend the whole budget on whichever single machine type is cheapest, ignoring every scenario

greedy: pool all scenarios into one average per-kind work total, then waterfill the budget across the matching SPECIALISTS ONLY (never the generalist, always a worse bang-per-buck for any single kind in isolation) proportional to that average demand -- ignores that scenarios don't overlap and that the frozen scheduler dumps any contention overflow straight onto a badly-mismatched specialist since there is no generalist fallback

strong: search directly on the true multi-scenario quantile-regret objective (marginal-gain construction + local swaps against the actual frozen-scheduler simulation), which discovers a mix of a couple of specialists plus 'wasteful' generalist units that the scheduler can always fall back on
invalid: submit a portfolio that wildly exceeds the budget
